preliminary.note: Retained diagnostic stages. Protocol 2 explicitly warms all scalar representations used by the final and legacy implementations; do not infer scalar/path improvements by comparing different warmup protocols. A concurrent JaxProp task was observed, not proven to be the sole cause of timing shifts.

limitations: Unpublished local JaxProp wheel; dependency-lock adoption requires a separately published patch.
Individual construction-order and historical absolute flags remain visible; balanced or paired results do not erase them.
Bicubic reporting batch shapes still require JIT compilation once per shape. Explicit warmup moves, rather than removes, startup work.
The legacy process-global get_property_fluid helper remains only in the two Rankine study families, assigned to Phase 7.
Manager reloads retain problem identity and replace the solver; external references to an old solver must not be reused after reload.
